name: Managers
desc: Name the football manager or national team coach from his clubs, trophies and moments.

100: Which Scottish manager led Manchester United for 26 years, retiring in 2013?
Sir Alex Ferguson
Which Spanish manager won four Premier League titles in a row with Manchester City (2021–2024)?
Pep Guardiola
Which German manager won the 2019 Champions League and the 2020 Premier League with Liverpool?
Jürgen Klopp
Which Portuguese manager won the Champions League with Porto in 2004 and Inter in 2010?
José Mourinho
Which Italian manager won the Champions League twice with AC Milan and three times with Real Madrid?
Carlo Ancelotti
Which Frenchman managed Arsenal's 'Invincibles', unbeaten through the 2003–04 league season?
Arsène Wenger
Which French legend won three Champions Leagues in a row as Real Madrid coach (2016–2018)?
Zinedine Zidane
Which former Arsenal captain, once Guardiola's assistant at Man City, became Arsenal manager in 2019?
Mikel Arteta
Which Argentine, known for his all-black outfits, took over Atlético Madrid in 2011 and won La Liga with them in 2014 and 2021?
Diego Simeone
Which Dutch manager replaced Jürgen Klopp and won the Premier League in his first season at Liverpool?
Arne Slot
Who coached Argentina to the 2022 World Cup?
Lionel Scaloni
Which Norwegian, who scored United's 1999 Champions League winner, managed Manchester United from 2018 to 2021?
Ole Gunnar Solskjær
200: Who coached Barcelona's MSN (Messi, Suárez, Neymar) to the 2015 treble?
Luis Enrique
Which Italian won the 2016–17 Premier League in his first season at Chelsea, switching to a back three?
Antonio Conte
Which Italian, nicknamed 'the Tinkerman', won the 2015–16 Premier League with 5000–1 outsiders Leicester?
Claudio Ranieri
Which Argentine took Tottenham to the 2019 Champions League final?
Mauricio Pochettino
Who coached Germany to the 2014 World Cup, including a 7–1 win over Brazil?
Joachim Löw
Who won the 2018 World Cup as France's coach, 20 years after lifting it as captain?
Didier Deschamps
Which German, who won the 2021 Champions League with Chelsea, became England head coach in 2025?
Thomas Tuchel
Which Brazilian coach, nicknamed 'Big Phil', won the 2002 World Cup?
Luiz Felipe Scolari
Which Spaniard led Bayer Leverkusen to an unbeaten Bundesliga title in 2023–24, then took over Real Madrid?
Xabi Alonso
Which Australian ended Tottenham's 17-year wait for a trophy by winning the 2025 Europa League?
Ange Postecoglou
Which Dutchman managed Ajax, then won the FA Cup (2024) and the League Cup (2023) with Manchester United?
Erik ten Hag
Which Spaniard managed Liverpool to the 2005 'Miracle of Istanbul'?
Rafael Benítez
300: Which chain-smoking Italian won the 2019 Europa League with Chelsea and Serie A with Juventus a year later?
Maurizio Sarri
Which Spaniard won the Europa League three times with Sevilla and once with Villarreal?
Unai Emery
Which Italian coached AC Milan to a 4–0 win over Barcelona in the 1994 Champions League final?
Fabio Capello
Which Dutchman coached co-hosts South Korea to the 2002 World Cup semi-finals?
Guus Hiddink
Which Chilean won the 2013–14 Premier League with Manchester City?
Manuel Pellegrini
Which Italian managed Manchester City to the 2011–12 title, won by Agüero's last-minute goal?
Roberto Mancini
Which Italian coached Italy to the 2006 World Cup?
Marcello Lippi
Which Portuguese coach took Egypt to the final of the 2021 Africa Cup of Nations, lost on penalties to Senegal?
Carlos Queiroz
Which South African coach won the CAF Champions League with Al Ahly in 2020 and 2021?
Pitso Mosimane
Which Italian led Napoli to the 2022–23 Serie A, their first title in 33 years?
Luciano Spalletti
Who coached Croatia to the 2018 World Cup final?
Zlatko Dalić
Which Dutch legend managed Barcelona's 'Dream Team' to their first European Cup in 1992?
Johan Cruyff
400: Which German coached Greece to their shock Euro 2004 title?
Otto Rehhagel
Which Portuguese coach won the 2011 Europa League with Porto aged just 33, then joined Chelsea?
André Villas-Boas
Which coach led Spain to Euro 2008, starting their run of three major titles?
Luis Aragonés
Which Frenchman led Liverpool to a cup treble (FA Cup, League Cup and UEFA Cup) in 2001?
Gérard Houllier
Which Portuguese coach won four CAF Champions Leagues with Al Ahly (2001, 2005, 2006 and 2008)?
Manuel José
Which American coached Egypt from 2011 to 2013, a spell that ended with a 6–1 loss to Ghana?
Bob Bradley
Which Mexican coached Egypt at the 2019 Africa Cup of Nations on home soil?
Javier Aguirre
Who coached France to the 1998 World Cup on home soil?
Aimé Jacquet
Which outspoken Englishman won two European Cups in a row (1979, 1980) with Nottingham Forest?
Brian Clough
Which Swiss coach won the CAF Champions League with Al Ahly in 2023 and 2024?
Marcel Koller
Which German, called the 'godfather of gegenpressing', was Manchester United's interim manager in 2021–22?
Ralf Rangnick
Who managed England to the 1966 World Cup?
Sir Alf Ramsey
500: Which Scot managed Celtic's 'Lisbon Lions' to the 1967 European Cup?
Jock Stein
Who coached Denmark to Euro 1992, after they were called up late to replace Yugoslavia?
Richard Møller Nielsen
Which Hungarian coach supposedly cursed Benfica never to win another European trophy, after leaving in 1962?
Béla Guttmann
Who coached Argentina to the 1978 World Cup on home soil?
César Luis Menotti
Who managed Liverpool to three European Cups (1977, 1978 and 1981)?
Bob Paisley
Who managed Blackburn Rovers to the 1994–95 Premier League title?
Kenny Dalglish
Who coached Egypt at the 1990 World Cup in Italy?
Mahmoud El-Gohary
Who took over Ivory Coast mid-tournament as interim coach and won the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations?
Emerse Faé
Which Argentine coached River Plate to the 2018 Copa Libertadores, beating Boca Juniors in a final played in Madrid?
Marcelo Gallardo
Which former Al Ahly coach led Egypt, unbeaten, from 2019 until he was sacked in 2021 after a draw with Gabon?
Hossam El-Badry
Who won the World Cup as a player in 1958 and 1962, then as Brazil's coach in 1970?
Mário Zagallo
Which Portuguese coach led Zamalek to the 2024 CAF Confederation Cup and the CAF Super Cup?
José Gomes
